Recorded claim:
The broad `+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*` refspec fetched all branches. Exclude `^refs/heads/beta`, `^refs/heads/release`, and `^refs/heads/esr*`, and set `remote.origin.tagOpt` to `--no-tags` to prevent recurrence. [Task 1]
